architectureUpgrade.pmGate: pm now requires problem validation, terminology clarification, scenario grounding, scope cutting, and understanding confirmation before PRD output.
architectureUpgrade.setupSkill: setup initializes docs/context.md, docs/adr, docs/out-of-scope, docs feedback directories, and .jingyuan/config.json.
architectureUpgrade.projectMemory: context, ADR, and out-of-scope references are defined under references/workflow/project-memory.md.
architectureUpgrade.dependencyPolicy: hard, soft, and optional dependency policy is defined under references/workflow/dependency-policy.md.
architectureUpgrade.verticalSlice: dev-plan and dev-builder reference vertical-slice.md for end-to-end task slicing.
architectureUpgrade.developmentArtifacts: dev-plan and dev-builder now support docs/changes/<change-id>/ proposal/spec/design/tasks artifacts while keeping docs/development/plan.md as the overview.
architectureUpgrade.testingPolicy: testing-policy.md defines behavior-first TDD, mock boundaries, and accepted replacement evidence for visual/config/bootstrap work.
architectureUpgrade.implementationCycle: implementation-cycle.md defines preflight, apply-style checkbox execution, scope drift detection, and stale verification rules.
architectureUpgrade.verificationGates: verification-gates.md defines completion statuses and fresh evidence requirements.
architectureUpgrade.diagnosticsLoop: diagnostics-loop.md defines reproducible feedback loops for bug fixes and baseline-first performance work.
architectureUpgrade.reviewReadiness: review-readiness.md defines two-stage review and stale review detection.
architectureUpgrade.fixLoop: fix now requires a reproducible validation loop before repair and a baseline before performance optimization.
architectureUpgrade.contextSlimming: long migrated skills were consolidated around current JingYuan references while preserving dependencies, gates, outputs, and routing behavior.
architectureUpgrade.feedbackEvolutionDependencies: feedback and evolution now declare startup dependencies, missing feedback behavior, and out-of-scope routing explicitly.
architectureUpgrade.documentConventionsChanges: document-conventions.md now includes docs/changes/<change-id>/ proposal/spec/design/tasks artifacts and old-path read-only compatibility.
architectureUpgrade.adrTemplateUse: setup now references adr-template.md as a decision-record template without creating empty ADR files.
architectureUpgrade.validationConsistency: validate-plugin.ps1 checks README skill mentions and validation-report skill count/list consistency.

windowsPowerShellAdaptation.processInterruption: PowerShell Get-NetTCPConnection + Stop-Process; Ctrl+C preferred for foreground services
windowsPowerShellAdaptation.sideEffectGate: git push, deploy, GitHub Release, npm publish, npm unpublish require explicit confirmation
windowsPowerShellAdaptation.skillDiscovery: Codex CLI discovers short skills as jingyuan:<skill> from flat skill mirrors under skills/jy-*; the complete plugin remains installed under plugins/jingyuan for shared assets and references.
windowsPowerShellAdaptation.pluginCompletionRow: Avoided by removing [plugins."jingyuan@local"] from config.toml; enabled plugins are shown by Codex as plugin-only completion rows.

validation.installWhatIf: passed with -Force -WhatIf because a local JingYuan install already exists
validation.tempInstall: passed: plugins/jingyuan, plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local, and skills/jy-setup plus all existing jy-* mirrors exist
validation.bomCheck: passed: plugin SKILL.md files start with raw --- bytes
validation.marketplaceEncoding: passed: marketplace.json is UTF-8 JSON without BOM
validation.configEnablement: passed: installer removes jingyuan@local enablement to avoid plugin-only completion row
validation.cacheInstall: passed: installer syncs plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local as a plugin payload cache
validation.promptInput: not run: verified flat mirror frontmatter names directly in temporary install

notes: Codex v0.122 shows every enabled plugin as a plugin-only completion row; JingYuan therefore uses flat skill mirrors for discovery while keeping the complete plugin payload installed.
The local installer defaults to the Codex home directory rather than the user home directory.

The installer keeps the complete plugin under plugins/jingyuan, syncs plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local, creates skills/jy-* mirrors with name: "jingyuan:<skill>", and removes obsolete flat skill discovery entries to avoid duplicate loading.
Shared assets and references are kept under plugins/jingyuan and are installed with the plugin.
Unix command examples are not used in primary skill flows; historical Claude references remain under references/claude-original.
